Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
